name: Doki Doki Mine Club
source:
Will you be able to spend the day of the update with any of these girls?

Doki Doki Mine Club is an adaptation of the Doki Doki Literature Club game in a Minecraft world with the characters from Mob Talker.
translation:
更新当天，你能和这些女孩中的某一位共度时光吗？

《Doki Doki Mine Club》以《心跳文学部》为基础，将故事搬进《我的世界》，并采用“怪物交谈”（Mob Talker）模组中的角色。
